funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Small, up to £2,000; Large, from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage of career who are the author or editor of the proposed publication; must have publisher confirmed and publication date within three years. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals seeking to disseminate research on British art through publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering practical publishing costs such as image licensing, subventions, contributor fees and translation costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £40,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed. One Research Project Grant per organisation per round.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research projects in the field of British art, primarily supporting staff costs towards facilitation of a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; exhibition from which the publication is based can be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays in British art, covering practical publishing costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £3,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis; items must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Funding to help protect and preserve significant works of British art by supporting organisations to undertake original and needed conservation research, covering staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants

amount.raw: Grants for any amount up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections relating to British art.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for organisations seeking to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Opportunity: Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA); pending members welcome. Available to emerging researchers in British art studies.
opportunities.summary: Research Travel Bursaries providing up to £250 to ERBA members to support research-related travel, such as visits to collections, exhibitions or archives, covering transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Available to individuals at any stage of career (up to £8,000); postdoctoral level or equivalent experience for £8,001-£20,000. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals undertaking research travel and/or taking time to address specific research questions in British art, supporting research time (including backfill) and research travel, plus some additional costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals enrolled to start (place confirmed) or already undertaking a master's level or doctoral level degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for students beginning or continuing a master's level or doctoral level degree in British art who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country.
opportunities.summary: Funding (drawn from the Andrew Wyld Fund) for registered students to undertake research trips to examine historical British works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if part time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's level degree (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) in British art that brings new perspectives to the field, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years (or split over further years); plus £500 per year for networking

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a doctorate degree at a UK-based university, starting between April 2027 and April 2028. International applicants eligible but amount fixed at £32,000/year.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support doctoral research in British art that expands understanding through new perspectives, paying university fees with remaining amount for living expenses.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: One year at £35,000, or two years at £70,000 (£35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake a major in-depth research project in British art that will reshape understanding of the field, part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, plus an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research on a British-Italian topic of cultural contact, exchange and influence, who would benefit from an extended stay in Rome.
